decision: held: the sources that match the record's applicability outcome ('metabolic' lipid/glycemic) are the meta-analyses 37263369, 34538515 and 35988871 and the pediatric trial 12487756, none of which has open full text; their abstracts give no verifiable regimen or included-trial list (35988871 is a network meta-analysis, which cannot carry credit). The open-access trials (30544795 hypertension endothelial markers, n=16; 25057105 HIV antioxidant capacity) and 38401078 (dyspepsia) fall outside the 'metabolic' scope. Existing pending contexts left unchanged. OA retry 2026-10-28: 37263369 (gold) and 35988871 (hybrid CC-BY-NC-ND) are on ScienceDirect, which blocks automated and browser-pane access; 34538515, 12487756 closed.
summary: 37263369 abstract: 20 studies (23 arms, 1076 participants) with lower LDL-C, TC and TG and higher HDL-C; 34538515: seven clinical studies with lower FBS/TC/TG. These lipid signals cannot be dose-verified from accessible text. Off-scope trials: 30544795 (4.5 g/day for 12 weeks, 16 ACE-inhibitor-treated hypertensive patients), 25057105 (5 g/day for 3 months, 73 HIV-positive women, no immunological difference), 38401078 (1.6 g/day for 2 months, rebound dyspepsia RR 0.63, reflux null).
